rules.coverage_text: All residential rental property in San Diego except those exempted under § 98.0703.

exemptions.description: Housing issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years
exemptions.quote: (k) housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome; and

exemptions.description: Tenant shares bathroom or kitchen with landlord who lives there
Deed-restricted or subsidized affordable housing (not Section 8)
Separately alienable property where landlord is not REIT, corporation, etc., with written notice

rules.quote: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
relations_hint: consistent with California Civil Code section 1946.2
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate a tenancy without at-fault or no-fault just cause as enumerated in the ordinance.
rules.title: Just cause required for termination of tenancy

rules.coverage_text: Residential rental property subject to the Division where tenancy is terminated for no-fault just cause.
rules.penalty: Not less than three times the required relocation assistance and actual economic damages (§ 98.0709(e))
rules.quote: (1) The landlord shall, regardless of the tenant’s income or length of tenancy and at the landlord’s option, provide relocation assistance to the tenant by one of the following:
rules.requirement: For no-fault just cause terminations, the landlord must provide relocation assistance by direct payment or rent waiver of two months' rent (three for seniors or disabled tenants).
rules.title: Relocation assistance for no-fault termination
